scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a very small monthly budget, [X] must buy summer tops while paying for a farewell outfit and ticket and preserving money for an upcoming trip, so the tops receive a hard share of the budget and nonessential additions are cut first.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 本月预算很少时，[X]既要买夏季上衣，又要支付欢送会服装和门票，还要为下月旅行留钱，因此上衣只能占用明确的一小部分预算，非必要的添置会优先取消。
examples: buying only the minimum number of summer tops needed this month
checking a sale or second-hand option before increasing the clothing share
dropping an extra top before reducing the farewell ticket or trip reserve

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a month-long budget stay in Osaka, [X] seeks one good anime T-shirt and compares specialist merchandise shops with official high-street collaborations and second-hand stores, balancing licensing, print and fabric quality, condition, and money still reserved for toys and daily travel.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在大阪进行一个月的低预算旅行时，[X]想买一件质量不错的动漫 T 恤，会比较动漫专卖店、平价品牌的官方联名和二手店，并在正版授权、印花与面料质量、成色，以及仍需留给玩具和日常旅行的费用之间权衡。
examples: choosing an affordable official collaboration instead of a specialty-store premium
buying second-hand only after checking the print and garment condition
paying more for one durable licensed shirt while buying fewer other souvenirs

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When replacing a basic denim jacket, [X] tests whether a luxury label's premium is justified by denser fabric, cleaner internal seams, stronger hardware, color retention, and repeated-wear durability rather than assuming a higher tag guarantees better quality than fast fashion.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备更换一件基础牛仔夹克时，[X]不会默认高价品牌一定更好，而会通过更扎实的面料、内侧缝线、五金强度、保色性和长期穿着耐久度，判断奢侈品牌相对快时尚款的溢价是否合理。
examples: choosing the lower-priced jacket when construction is comparable
paying more after checking seams, hardware, and fabric weight in person
rejecting a logo premium that adds no useful durability

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After spending most of a tight concert budget on the ticket and transport but still wanting a distinctive outfit, [X] compares restyling owned tops, borrowing from friends, swapping clothes, thrifting, and making a small alteration instead of treating a new trendy top as mandatory.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 紧张的演唱会预算大多已经用于门票和交通、但仍想穿得有特点时，[X]会比较重新搭配现有上衣、向朋友借、交换衣物、淘二手和做小改造，而不是把购买全新的潮流上衣当成必需。
examples: restyling or altering an owned top at almost no added cost
borrowing or swapping for a one-night look
buying one inexpensive thrifted piece only when the existing wardrobe cannot work

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While reducing new clothing purchases but remaining uneasy about cleanliness and wear in second-hand tops, [X] considers price together with platform inspection, disclosed condition, washable odors or marks, remaining fabric life, and environmental benefit over buying new.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 希望减少购买新衣、却担心二手上衣的卫生和磨损时，[X]会把价格与平台质检、成色说明、气味或污渍是否可清洗、面料剩余寿命，以及相对购买新品的环保收益一起考虑。
examples: choosing a low-priced top only when its condition is clearly documented
paying a little more on a quality-controlled resale platform
buying new when cleaning and repair would erase the second-hand saving

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing one white T-shirt to wear repeatedly with jeans, [X] compares affordable high-street and premium options by opacity, shape retention, seam quality, comfort, and cost per wear rather than automatically buying the cheapest or most prestigious label.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 组建简洁休闲衣橱并想选一件能反复搭配牛仔裤的白 T 恤时，[X]会根据透光程度、版型保持、缝线、舒适度和单次穿着成本比较平价品牌与高端款，而不是自动选择最便宜或最有名的品牌。
examples: choosing an affordable basic after checking opacity and stitching
paying more for a shirt that keeps its shape through frequent washing
rejecting a premium option that offers no better repeat-wear value

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before an Italian summer trip, [X] looks for breathable, chic tops and compares affordable organic basics with pricier sustainable European brands, including delivery or customs risk, natural-fiber content, expected longevity, and whether one better blouse can replace several disposable holiday purchases.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在意大利夏季旅行前寻找透气又利落的上衣时，[X]会比较平价有机基础款与价格更高的欧洲可持续品牌，并把配送或关税风险、天然纤维含量、预期寿命，以及一件更好的衬衫能否替代多件一次性度假服装纳入判断。
examples: choosing an affordable certified cotton basic for a short trip
paying more for one linen blouse expected to remain in regular use
rejecting an overseas option when fees erase its apparent value

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a half-day solo outing in East London, [X] shops for one leather jacket and compares a carefully inspected vintage piece, a new high-street jacket, and an investment heritage model by grain condition, cracking at stress points, fit, construction, uniqueness, and expected years of wear.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在东伦敦安排半日独处行程时，[X]想买一件皮夹克，会在仔细检查过的古着款、全新的商业品牌款和可长期持有的传统品牌款之间，根据皮面状态、受力处开裂、合身度、做工、独特性和预期穿着年限进行比较。
examples: buying vintage when the leather is supple and the stress points are sound
choosing a mid-priced new jacket for predictable condition and fit
paying an investment price only when construction and long-term use justify it

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a budget-conscious family travels from Tokyo to the colder Japanese Alps, [X] audits each child's layers for a long outdoor festival evening and buys a missing thermal top or light jacket at an ordinary city store only if borrowing, rewearing, and laundry cannot close the gap before tourist-area prices rise.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与控制预算的家庭从东京前往更冷的日本阿尔卑斯地区前，[X]会先核对每个孩子在户外观看夜间祭典所需的分层衣物；只有借用、重复穿和洗衣仍无法补足时，才会在普通城市门店购买缺少的保暖上衣或轻便夹克，避免到旅游区后支付更高价格。
examples: rewearing and laundering layers that already cover the temperature range
buying one inexpensive missing thermal layer before reaching the festival town
paying more for a light jacket only when it protects a child through repeated cold outings

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing a short destination whose weather matches the lightweight tops already worn at home, [X] treats the ability to leave without buying a different travel wardrobe as part of affordability and keeps only a small contingency for an unexpected layer.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 选择与居住地天气相近的短途目的地时，[X]会让现有轻薄上衣直接沿用，把无需另买旅行衣橱视为可负担性的一部分，只为意外需要的一层衣物保留少量余量。
examples: spending nothing on tops when the existing summer wardrobe fits the forecast
reserving only a small amount for one unexpected layer
rejecting an otherwise cheap destination when it requires several new tops
